test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following rivers is also called Vitasta?
solution: The correct answer is __**Jhelum.**__ __** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__** • **Jhelum is also called **Vitasta**.** • A spring, Verinag is the source of the Jhelum river which flows across the Kashmir valley. • It is located in the vicinity of Banihal Pass, 20kms from Anantnag, • It is the first tourist spot of Kashmir valley when travelling from Jammu by road.
